thread:
Marta (CS): Quick note 1 Sprucewell onboarding usage looks strong but we're seeing tail p95 creep on /chat during evenings. Proactive recommendation: spin an int8 compact canary + split routing for 24h to validate cost/latency/quality tradeoffs ahead of renewal. Need infra + SRE help and an enablement call with the customer.

Leo (Infra): Can you dump the last 48h p95/qps/error and the exact model currently in use? Also which region most traffic hits?

Marta (CS): Console snapshot:
```
period: 2026-03-22T00:00->2026-03-23T12:00Z
endpoint: /api/chat
model: redwood-base-7b
qps: baseline 48 -> peak 110
p95: 1.2s -> 1.6s
error: 0.3% -> 0.9%
region: eu-west-1 (~72%), us-west-2 (~18%)
```

Leo (Infra): OK. Proposal: start 15% traffic to compact-1, 85% to base-7b during eu-west evening peak. Add auto-rollback on latency and eval score. Jamal, can you handle KV warmup?

Jamal (SRE): Yep. Ops checklist:
- Deploy canary in eu-west-1 dedicated pool
- Seed KV cache with top 50 prefixes
- Run pre/post quality eval on 12 prompts
- Rollback triggers: p95 > 2s OR error_delta > 0.5% OR eval_drop > 1.5 pts
I'll own monitoring and rollback hooks. Marta, share prompts.

Anya (AE): Renewal in ~6 weeks. If we show ~30-40% token cost reduction for routed traffic, strong upsell for reserved capacity. But customer prioritizes latency 8 keep split low and keep QA controls obvious on the enablement call.

Marta (CS): Can we book a 15m enablement call tomorrow 10:00am PT with Sprucewell eng lead? I'll share prompts and dashboard screenshots. Infra + SRE able to join?

Leo (Infra): I'll join. Draft CLI to create route:
```
retool routes create --customer sprucewell --name sprucewell-compact-canary \
  --endpoint /api/chat --models "compact-1:0.15,redwood-base-7b:0.85" \
  --region eu-west-1 --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 \
  --health-checks "p95<2000ms,error_rate_delta<0.5%,eval_score>=98" \
  --duration 24h
```

Jamal (SRE): I'll prepare the eval harness, seed cache, and add a per-token latency tracer. Will post pre/post eval summary in this thread during the canary window.

deploy-bot: Canary route 'sprucewell-compact-canary' scheduled for 2026-03-23T18:00:00Z on pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1'. Rollout events will post to #eng-runtime and monitoring hooks to Datadog.

Marta (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll notify the customer and upload the prompt set here. Keeping this thread as the SOT.

Leo (Infra): LGTM. I'll watch the first two hours closely.

Anya (AE): I'll draft the one-pager on projected savings + SLA caveats for renewal collateral.

Jamal (SRE): Ack. Pre-run results will be attached here when ready.

(reactions: :thumbsup: Anya, :eyes: Leo)
